doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Meeting Buddy Collette and Charles Mingus
summary: He met Buddy Collette by sitting in at a Watts dance, their groups merged after a Million Dollar Theater audition, and Mingus, then a cellist, came into the circle.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: So you meet Dexter. Because many of your biographies published say you went to high school with Dexter Gordon, with Illinois Jacquet, with Charles Mingus, Buddy Collette.

And Jack Kelso. And they all said that you played in bands so let’s go over each one of those folks. We already talked about your meeting Jack Kelso. We just talked about your meeting Dex. How about meeting Mingus?
Mingus, I met Mingus man, through Buddy.
So let’s talk about Buddy. Buddy seems to be a real key figure.

Buddy had a group and they were out in Watts. And one night, I think it was Saturday or something, I went out there to hear them. And I didn’t know Buddy, Buddy didn’t know me. So they were playing a dance you know and he had his -- I can’t think of his name, but anyway Charlie Drayton’s brother-in-law, Red -- I can’t think of -- you know Drayton, trumpet player, Leslie Drayton? Well anyway to make a long story short, I come out there, right, so Buddy said he saw me. He said man, I saw this dude. I was sharp then. I was dressed, you know. So I asked could I sit in, you know, and he let me sit in and, you know, well who’s this dude, you know. So I came back home in LA. Next thing I know we have a gig. We make an audition to play the Million Dollar Theater, play in a show with --remember (Unintelligible) McKinney?

To play a show. So our group played an opposite audition, opposite of Buddy. Buddy had his group and so some kind of way the two groups came together and I ended up being the drummer with the group and that’s how we virtually in a sense got started.
So this is how you met Buddy, and you met Mingus at the same time?
Oh, yeah. I think at that time Mingus was playing cello.

No, he wouldn’t play no jazz cello, he was playing cello. I mean Buddy turned him on to that, plus the fact when Mingus started studying with Red Calendar. That’s when -- well when we all got in the band, high school band, that’s when we all you know -- that’s when everything began to come together.
